sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You may spend a majority of your time on your health and well-being today. Business lunch may see some pending negotiations reaching a successful outcome. Research work will progress better than expected, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: I told you so might be your motto of the day. Try not to rub this in other people's faces, Taurus. Indeed, you have the foresight to witness an action and see the consequences right away. These consequences might rear their ugly heads on a day like this. Use your incredible perception and intuition to home in on the best solution possible and work toward that goal before things get out of hand.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: The Capricorn Moon and Saturn square off early this morning, dearest Taurus, highlighting issues you've been ignoring. This celestial clash creates a pressurized atmosphere, which could trigger intense dreams or restlessness. Luckily, you can make this energy work in your favor, but avoidant cycles will need to be broken immediately. If you are willing to accept signs the universe is sending, you'll have a chance to learn, grow, and overcome obstacles. If you require support along the way, ask your higher power for help.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Outdoor activities will be tiring and stressful today. Don't overspend too much in order to impress others. Your careless attitude will make parents worry. You need to take them in confidence before starting any new project. As you like to carry out your favourite activity in free time, you'll think of doing something similar even today. However, you won't be able to fulfil your plan due to an uninvited guest. The day might become one of the best days of your married life. Don't start anything new unless you have finished your previous work. Not following this advice can land you in a big soup.

Meanwhile, a supportive aspect transforms your dreams. Don't give up on that wild scheme yet. It may yield results soon.
